no_approval_required_because: The page carries no verbatim text from any restricted source. Its prose, figures and tables are original content under the repository's Apache-2.0 licence, and the report is text-free with respect to third-party corpora -- it redistributes row hashes and scores, never prompts. The one dependency it used to have is now withheld: build.py's redact_restricted_rows() holds back the v1_hmda2022 prompt text that the worked G0/D1 case study quoted, keeping the row id, gold labels, cited policy cards, per-guard scores and ranks, all of which are ours. Verified absent from the built page: the full MGB-UD-00020 prompt, the MGB-FL-00028 fragment, and every other verbatim run of either row. The two-word phrases 'market fit' and 'resale stability' remain in our own analytic prose describing what the row does, which is not redistribution of the row.

history.why_it_no_longer_applies: The requirement was real: the case study quoted one row of that source verbatim, and the source is local_only with permits_redistribution unknown. It was removed by withholding the quotation, NOT by approving the source. The source's own DATA_CARD.md still reads 'LICENSE NOT YET SELECTED' and names an FFIEC/CFPB terms-of-use check as a precondition; that check has not been done and no reviewer is on record. Nothing here relaxes that -- the ledger entry is untouched.

redaction.escape_hatch: python build.py --with-restricted-text produces the full-text edition for local reading; that output is NOT publishable while the ledger is unresolved.
redaction.fails_closed: The function raises RedactionError if either quotation anchor stops matching, so a regenerated or reworded case study stops the build instead of silently publishing the prompt.

quotation_budget.note: The budget bounds how much restricted vocabulary this page may carry and fails the build if it grows. It is a change detector, not an authorization; this file records the authorization requirement, which is now none.

gate.current_reason: The artifact declares no source dependencies, because it carries no restricted text. The refusal path stays under test via tests/fixtures/pages_artifact_unapproved/.
